properties.notes: Cloud 9 boardwalk → Guyam Island → Sugba Lagoon. Base yourself in General Luna; hire a tricycle/habal-habal and a boat for island hopping.
Balanghai Shrine → National Museum – Butuan → Agusan Marsh Wildlife Sanctuary. Doable in a day by tricycle/van from Butuan City, and the two museum stops are free.
